identity: &The garishly-dressed hunter greets you with a surprised glance, but ultimately, a sly smile and a haughty accent.  An Exodii rifle is resting against the table.  "You, yes you.  I've heard of you.  I'm a collector, you see, and well, I am told we've developed a rather practical appetite for, let us say, mechanical delights.  So, I've taken the liberty of collecting and cleaning a few choice specimens.  Do have a look.  These are the finest cuts of alien machinery you're likely to find this side of oblivion."

identity: A sturdy leather belt and powered air purifying respirator blower designed for exploring the apocalyptic wasteland.  On one side hangs an archaic dagger sheath.  The other side has a custom open-top pouch lined with 10 cartridge loops fit for 27.3x Diyua grenades.  Mounted to the back is a spartan PAPR blower, shielded in plastic, with connections for a bionic interface.  If loaded with a filter and paired with a PAPR mask this will protect from all manner of post-apocalyptic environmental threats.  Activate it to turn it on.
